title: Effects of Al addition on the microstructures and properties of MoNbTaTiV refractory high entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting in a water-cooled copper crucible under a Ti-getter high purity argon atmosphere, remelted 5 times for chemical homogeneity, then drop-casted into a copper mold with diameter of 8 mm
